# Pinterest Brasil

> > Pinterest Brasil is the Brazilian Portuguese version of Pinterest, featuring curated trends, DIY tutorials, lifestyle inspiration, and creative ideas tailored for Brazilian audiences.

The platform showcases daily trending content across fashion, beauty, home decor, and creative projects. Pinterest Brasil serves as the official hub for Brazilian users seeking visual inspiration, with curated boards covering everything from seasonal trends to DIY tutorials and lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest Brasil
- Brazilian lifestyle content
- Daily trends and inspiration
- DIY and tutorials
- Fashion and beauty
- Home decor and interior design
- Curated boards
- Portuguese-language content
- Seasonal trends
- Creative projects
- Visual inspiration
- Casa Vogue
- Style guides
- Social media curation

## Core Pinterest Brasil

- [Pinterest Brasil (pinterestbr) - Profile | Pinterest](https://br.pinterest.com/pinterestbr/): Official Pinterest Brasil profile with curated Brazilian content boards
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://br.pinterest.com/today/): Curated daily trends in fashion, beauty & lifestyle on Pinterest

## DIY and Creative Projects

- [900+ ideias de faça você mesmo e tutoriais para salvar hoje | faça você mesmo, tutoriais, diy e muito mais](https://br.pinterest.com/pinterestbr/faça-você-mesmo-e-tutoriais/): Pinterest Brasil's DIY tutorials & creative project ideas board

- [900+ melhores ideias de Decoração em 2026 | decoração, ideias de decoração, interior de design](https://br.pinterest.com/casavoguebrasil/decoração/): Casa Vogue's curated interior design & home decor ideas board
- [890 melhores ideias de Desenhos em 2026 | desenhos aleatórios, ideias para desenho, desenhando esboços](https://br.pinterest.com/stayane263/desenhos/): User board with 890 drawing ideas, sketches & art inspiration
- [Duducrochet (duducrochet) - Profile | Pinterest](https://br.pinterest.com/duducrochet/): Duducrochet profile featuring crochet patterns & design boards
